# 说明: 这是语音输入工具的配置文件示例，请复制为 config.json 并填入你的API密钥
# Description: This is an example configuration file for the Voice Input Tool. Please copy to config.json and fill in your API keys.
# ASR提供商类型: 可选值: openai_compatible(OpenAI兼容格式) / doubao(豆包大模型) / volcengine(火山引擎)
# 豆包应用密钥: 仅当 asr_provider 为 doubao 或 volcengine 时需要填写
# Doubao App Key: Required only when asr_provider is doubao or volcengine
# 火山引擎访问密钥: 仅当 asr_provider 为 doubao 或 volcengine 时需要填写
# Volcengine Access Key: Required only when asr_provider is doubao or volcengine
# 豆包资源ID: 仅当 asr_provider 为 doubao 时需要填写
# Doubao Resource ID: Required only when asr_provider is doubao
# 火山引擎集群名称: 仅当 asr_provider 为 volcengine 时需要填写
# Volcengine Cluster Name: Required only when asr_provider is volcengine
# ASR识别模式: 仅当 asr_provider 为 doubao 时需要填写，可选值: bigmodel_async / bigmodel / bigmodel_nostream
# ASR Recognition Mode: Required only when asr_provider is doubao. Options: bigmodel_async / bigmodel / bigmodel_nostream
# OpenAI兼容API基础地址: 仅当 asr_provider 为 openai_compatible 时需要填写
# OpenAI Compatible API Base URL: Required only when asr_provider is openai_compatible
# OpenAI兼容API密钥: 仅当 asr_provider 为 openai_compatible 时需要填写
# OpenAI Compatible API Key: Required only when asr_provider is openai_compatible
# 模型名称: 仅当 asr_provider 为 openai_compatible 时需要填写
# Model Name: Required only when asr_provider is openai_compatible
# 主题模式: light=亮色主题, dark=暗色主题
# 界面语言: 可选值: zh_CN(简体中文) / zh_TW(繁体中文) / en(English) / fr(法语) / es(西班牙语) / ru(俄语) / ja(日语) / ko(韩语) / de(德语) / pt(葡萄牙语) / it(意大利语) / nl(荷兰语) / pl(波兰语) / tr(土耳其语) / vi(越南语)
# Interface Language: Options: zh_CN / zh_TW / en / fr / es / ru / ja / ko / de / pt / it / nl / pl / tr / vi
# ITN数字转换: true=开启（将「十五六个」转为「15~16个」）, false=关闭
# 主题颜色配置: 一般无需修改，可自定义界面颜色
# Theme Color Configuration: Generally no need to modify, can customize interface colors
